scope.proposed_path: reuse the already-loaded screened composed base LP in the same request-local Highs owner; append signed low-rank ReLU corrections and one topologically ordered native RANGE definition per selected flip
scope.oracle: the current full target rebuild was materialized only after proposed-path timing, evaluated at the low-rank factors, and never solved

algebra.delta: D is one K-column forward influence pass under the simultaneously flipped target mask; every selected ReLU cuts incoming influence and injects one in its own column
algebra.existing_flipped_row: retain its base-oriented coefficients and change the finite upper bound to the numerically identical finite lower bound; no x coefficient mutation is needed
algebra.exact_relation: with exact definitions the auxiliary formulation eliminates to the complete simultaneously flipped affine cell
algebra.loaded_relation: native RANGE widening for unavoidable tiny coefficients is an outward candidate superset; candidate rows and margins have no verdict authority

tiny_contract.aux_bounds: finite topological interval recursion over x and preceding auxiliary bounds
tiny_contract.objective: any nonzero coefficient with abs<=1e-12 fails closed
